_: Hand-written ground truth for fixtures/ts-coverage, read by
Every entry was read out of coverage/lcov.info and the fixture sources by hand, against the
symbol line extents the index records. If the implementation disagrees with this file,
A symbol with no covered line has no entry, because it must have no edge: absence is the
answer to the gap question and a NOT_COVERED edge would be a negative claim in a
positive-evidence store. Those symbols are listed under `no_edge` so that the absence is
`covered` counts DA: lines inside the symbol's extent with a non-zero hit count;
`instrumented` counts DA: lines inside it whatever their hit count. `degree` is `covered`
when the two are equal and `partial` otherwise, and `partial` is never rounded.

covers.note: extent 1-3; DA:1,1 and DA:2,3 are both inside it and both ran. Line 3 is a closing brace and is not instrumented, which is why `covered` is judged against instrumented lines rather than against the extent
DA:7,0 — the `return low` branch never ran. One unexecuted instrumented line is enough to make the symbol partial, and partial is a recorded value
only the class declaration line is instrumented and inside the class but outside every method; lines 4-15 belong to the innermost symbol that covers them, which is never the class
extent 4-7, nested inside Rectangle's extent 3-16; innermost_covering picks the constructor because its byte span is the shorter one
the method definition line ran when the class was defined; DA:14,0 says the body never did. Entered is not executed, and the row says so

no_edge.note: DA:15,0 and DA:16,0 — instrumented and never executed. No edge at all, in either direction
an interface the report never mentions. Absence in the report is absence in the graph

unattributed_lines.note: the `import` statement executes and is instrumented, and it is inside no symbol. Counted under line-outside-any-symbol rather than attached to the class below it
